blocking_reasons.requirement: observe a real physical stylus contacting the Android device during the active Protocol v1 session
run a stable signed Host with Screen Recording and Accessibility permission ready

missing_requirements.requirement: observe a real physical stylus contacting the Android device during the active Protocol v1 session
retain same-session Android diagnostic logs with Stylus forwarded samples from a stylus or eraser tool
retain newly appended Host Stylus injected logs with contact, pressure, and signed two-axis tilt
run a stable signed Host with Screen Recording and Accessibility permission ready
record the visible macOS drawing-app result of the physical stylus stroke
retain the bounded Android diagnostic log window for the drawing attempt
retain the newly appended Host log observation window for the drawing attempt
use a collector result whose own status is pass, not blocked or failed

notes: Capability-only Nubia P0110/pacific snapshot. getevent-lp.txt records goodix_stylus_input with BTN_STYLUS, BTN_STYLUS2, ABS_PRESSURE, ABS_TILT_X, ABS_TILT_Y, and ABS_DISTANCE; BTN_TOOL_PEN and BTN_TOOL_RUBBER were not exposed in this snapshot. No physical drawing observation window was attempted.
required_device_identity: Record the actual Android device identity; Nubia P0110/pacific/Android 16 evidence must not be relabeled as Xiaomi 13/fuxi.
